windows.notes: Central Anatolia winter wheat sown Oct-Nov (per agricultural advisors).
Wheat harvest Jun-Jul (Konya plain harvest began 24 Jun 2026; TMO purchases from 22 Jun 2026).
Barley sown late Sep-Oct (slightly ahead of wheat).
Barley harvested in June, ~15-20 days before wheat (Konya).
Aegean cotton sown Apr-May; soil temperature >=15 °C is the sowing trigger.
Southeast cotton sown Apr-May per the 15 °C soil-temperature rule. Harvest window end unverified — no harvest window seeded.
Thrace oilseed sunflower sown early Apr-mid May; soil >=8-10 °C at germination; early sowing raises yield.
Thrace sunflower harvest mid-Aug to end Sep (Trakya Birlik).
Mediterranean/Çukurova grain maize sown late Apr-mid May (Çukurova sowing reported from 10 Mar 2026).
Mediterranean maize harvest from early Aug (Adana, 2025).
Southeast grain maize sown late Apr-mid May. 2nd-crop maize after wheat: sow Jun-Jul, harvest Oct-Nov (not seeded as a separate window).
Southeast maize harvest Aug-Sep (parallel to Mediterranean timing).
